rules.action: Stop dependent motion, observe support, secure a compatible carrier, then retry with a new bounded attempt

rules.trigger: film tear or wrong layer count
rules.action: Support assembly, remove affected cover, install two identified layers, increment revision and repeat assembly inspection
Mark affected data invalid, reattach and check electrical/contact configuration; requalify calibration if probe/channel conditions invalidate it
Mount and inspect the new accessory; acquire a valid new reference before sample measurement

rules.trigger: heater output unknown or sensor feedback lost
rules.action: Request output off, verify actual readback; remain blocked while output state is unknown
Stop or pause the affected acquisition, retain partial intervals and schedule a new eligible session without inventing data

retry_limit: episode-supplied finite integer; not an infinite retry-until-success rule
